limitations: Raw C/S are not recomputed here; this audits saved full-recompute evidence and exact integer algebra.
Every initial/coarse/child/pass label is freshly hashed and its structural role is checked.
Source/binary/audit/fit/graph identities are inherited from the accepted partition manifests; this script does not reopen those inputs.
Structure conditions are necessary only; paired oracle search transfer remains required before P3 can pass.
No pilot/validation/held-out data, new CI, tuning or performance claim is used.

semantics.QPS: Use stored qps_mean_of_five, without recomputing. Median, pooled and five round values remain separate.
semantics.Recall: Stored fraction unchanged; paired deltas and CIs are stored percentage points unchanged.
semantics.CI: All saved pointwise ordinary 95% bootstrap intervals are exploratory and unadjusted; no new interval is computed.
semantics.Fast_frontier_counters: Unmeasured zero sentinels replaced with null. Other missing P2 frontier counters are not reported by this source.
semantics.oracle: Oracle methods use GT and are diagnostic; no deployment/performance improvement claim follows.
semantics.P3_cross_model_wall: Fixed model order makes cross-model wall/QPS descriptive only, without paired timing inference.
semantics.instrumented_time: Instrumented routing/graph time is not pure wall latency. A routing-only batch is not per-query latency.
semantics.reused_GT: Historical exact-GT cost is null/unknown, never zero; no complete training-time sum is invented.
semantics.shared_cost: P3 frequency/greedy model cost pointers share one probe run per lambda; never sum duplicates.
semantics.nested_bootstrap_status: Copied source bootstrap metadata can contain initial INCOMPLETE invocation status despite completed top-level analysis; preserve it, do not reinterpret completion.
semantics.source_flags: P2/P3 stage/gate fields here are copied analysis-scope flags; this table generator does not read or change current gate files.
